entities.title: human-assisted-software-development
entities.summary: Human-assisted software development (HASD): .dev folders next to the code, holding diagrams, behavior views and knowledge files.
entities.relevance: In a repository that follows it, requirements.md and architecture.md point at the .dev folders rather than repeating them (README.md, step 4 of "Using the templates"; the opening comment of requirements.md; architecture.md, "Known debt"). Its knowledge catalogue maps each of the twelve documents to the kinds adapted from it.
